Description: The harness supplies invented dimensional fixture values as raw f64 values and records provenance, but it does not declare fixture unit metadata or a unit-system reference.
ProposedDisposition: Technical disposition proposed: BenchmarkFixture now carries a FrameKernelUnitBasis and HarnessRunRecord preserves the unit-system reference; README states fixture metadata declares a reproducibility basis only and supplies no conversion catalog or performance reliance. Evidence: cargo test --manifest-path core/solver/performance_harness/Cargo.toml passed 6 tests on 2026-05-16.
